user.title: my e-PASS credentials
user.description: Pick your toll operator, then sign in with the username and password you use on its portal. Remember that both are case sensitive.

account.title: Choose account
account.description: Your login has more than one e-PASS account. Pick the one to add. Repeat the setup to add the others.

transponders.title: Choose transponders
transponders.description: {count} transponder(s) found. Keep “All” to follow every transponder on the account (including ones added later), or pick specific ones.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The password for {username} is no longer accepted by my e-PASS.

error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.
abort.no_accounts: This login has no e-PASS accounts linked to it.
abort.no_transponders: No transponders found on this account.

data_description.scan_interval_minutes: How often to poll my e-PASS. The portal is not fast, so keep this at 15 minutes or more.

get_receipt.name: Get receipt
get_receipt.description: Fetches the operator's receipt for one top-up order.

order_id.name: Order ID
order_id.description: The order id of the payment, as reported by the gr_epass_payment_ready event.

wait.name: Wait for it
wait.description: Keep retrying for up to thirty seconds. The bank confirms the payment out of band, so a receipt asked for immediately after paying is not there yet.

entry_id.name: Subscription
entry_id.description: Which subscription to ask. Only needed with more than one set up.

send_link.name: Send payment link
send_link.description: Sends the current payment link to a notification target.

target.name: Send to
target.description: A notify entity. Defaults to the one set in the integration options.

entry_id.name: Subscription
entry_id.description: Which subscription to use. Only needed with more than one set up.

no_loaded_entry.message: No e-PASS subscription is set up.

entry_id_required.message: Several subscriptions are set up, so entry_id is required.

no_order_id.message: No order id given and no payment has been handed to the bank yet.
